note: Makes added when the fueleconomy.gov adapter grew from electric vehicles to the whole market, reviewed by the same rule as vehicle-makers.json: a make is mapped only where the EPA manufacturer code that certifies its 2026 vehicles belongs to the LEI holder's group, and the LEI was confirmed active in GLEIF. None of these makes has an electric vehicle in the 2026 or 2027 file, so the electric-vehicles lens is unchanged by this file. Still unmapped: Mazda (SBTi lists Mazda Motor Europe, a European sales company, not Mazda Motor Corporation), Kia (SBTi's record has no LEI), Honda, Subaru, Mitsubishi and the Stellantis makes (no SBTi record), and Rolls-Royce (its own EPA code under BMW).
